Bangladesh Floods Cause Widespread Damage and Deaths

Severe flash floods have hit Bangladesh, particularly the Chittagong region, leading to significant destruction and loss of life. Reports indicate at least 44 fatalities, with widespread power outages affecting several areas. The military has been deployed to Chittagong to assist with the crisis.
